items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock May Be Overvalued On Kemerton Idling News
items.snippet: Albemarle trades at P/S 1.8x vs peers 1.8x and chemicals industry 1.2x; Kemerton idled from Feb 2026; stock -65.4% over 5 years.

items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded ALB to Outperform, PT $130. Q3 results due Nov 4. 16 of 26 analysts rate Buy/Strong Buy, 8 Hold.

items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: Q2 Energy Storage volumes +11%, realized price +61% to $19.53/kg, segment adj. EBITDA +229% to $723M. Silver Peak the only active US lithium mine; Kings Mountain permits sought.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Underperform view: weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, supply-chain cost impact $70-90M in 2026; CGP3 ramp delayed after June 9, 2026 fire.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus keeps Buy; lithium +67% y/y but below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.
